content: Take genre staples like Gone Girl or The Silent Patient. While the two couldn’t be more different in tone and subject matter, both thrillers heavily rely on misdirection and the recontextualization of events to deliver twists. These picks are a staple in every “must-read” list for good reason, just like the ones Polygon has highlighted below as genre essentials. Without further ado, here are eight thriller books you should read at least once in your life.
